# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Seasoned Senior Quality & Test Automation Lead with over 19 years of software quality engineering experience delivering end-to-end testing strategies across enterprise web applications, APIs, and modern cloud platforms. Proven automation specialist skilled in architecting scalable frameworks with Playwright and TypeScript, leveraging custom AI tools and LLM workflows to accelerate test creation, defect analysis, and continuous delivery. Google Cloud Generative AI certified and ISTQB-accredited leader with demonstrated success driving CI/CD automation pipelines, security vulnerability assessments, and cross-functional release readiness in fast-paced Agile environments.
